column2: LinuxCNC + Mesa 7i80HDT (Ethernet FPGA host) with 7i44 on P1 (RS-422 sserial to 7i84U-A on port 0 and 7i84U-B on port 1) + 7i49 on P2 (X/Y/Z resolvers + AOUT0..4 servo/spindle command); P3 unused/spare except bare gpio.042 probe input
COMMISSIONING_PENDING and ACCEPTED_VERIFY require cabinet verification before wiring or energizing outputs. HOLD_CONFLICT requires resolution first.
Axis feedback is Tamagawa TS2014N resolver feedback through the 7i49 on P2, not quadrature encoder feedback.
The hardware E-stop chain removes hazardous power. 7i84U-A TB1 IN29 is the sole software monitor input; the OEM hardware chain remains authoritative.
7i49 AOUT order is X=AOUT0, Z=AOUT1, Y=AOUT2, FR-SX spindle velocity=AOUT3, FR-SX orient reference=AOUT4 (reserved).
7i80HDT P1/P2/P3 map; 7i44 sserial-port map; 7i49 resolver + analog map; 7i84U-A and 7i84U-B field I/O; bare P3 gpio.042 probe exception; HAL cross-reference; open items/conflicts.
